extremesVsNormals.means: Survival outcomes currently use monthly-mean climatology (coldest/warmest month means, freezingRisk from means) plus qualitative plant traits — NOT absolute extreme minima/maxima, frost-day counts, or heat-event frequency.
extremesVsNormals.falsePositiveRisk: A plant may survive mean winters yet fail rare hard freezes / heat waves. Without extreme-risk authority, Survival=Reliable must not be marketed as extreme-event proof.
extremeFieldsAudited: extreme cold / hard-freeze absolute min — NOT in V2 profiles
extreme heat absolute max / heat-wave frequency — NOT in V2 profiles
frost-day frequency — NOT in V2 profiles

seasonalWaterBalance.method: monthly P/PET from stored series; dry month AI<0.5; warm-season drought class

climateVsGardenSite.overallMeaning: Backward-compatible Overall reflects CLIMATE_SUITABILITY (plus safe demotions). It is NOT a complete garden-site assessment when sun/drainage/irrigation/container are unknown.

hemispherePhenology: thermal seasons + latitude hemisphere; equatorial not forced

cultivarPrecision: species evidence must not become cultivar-specific precision
